title: Processing Human Colon Muscle Layers for Single Nuclei RNA-seq Using PHOX2B Antibody Immunoselection
author: Christina M Wright
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.w3afgie
materials: Homogenize the lysate by vortexing for 30s.
Discard the column and keep the flow-through.
Follow the instructions on the Qiagen RNeasy Micro Kit for this section
Pre-cool the Dounce homogenizer and pestles on ice.
Pre-cool large and small centrifuges to 4 C.
Leave on ice for 15 minutes to block.
Invert the tubes ~5 times to wash.

steps.title: Prepare Equipment and Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the workspace and necessary reagents before tissue arrival.

substeps.instruction: Spray forceps and scissors with RNase Away, then rinse/soak in water.
Chill methylbutane in a petri dish on dry ice by adding a few pieces of dry ice into the liquid.
Dilute 10 mg/mL Hoechst 1:4 in nuclease-free water to make 2.5 mg/mL; filter using a 3 mL syringe and 0.22 micron filter, and store at 4°C.
Prepare blocking serum by filtering Normal Donkey Serum in 10 mL of sterile 1x PBS using a 3 mL syringe and 0.22 micron filter.
Prepare Nonidet P40 substitute by adding 1 mL of RNase free Nonidet P40 substitute to 9 mL of RNase free water; dissolve on a rotator for 30 minutes.
Rinse large iridectomy scissors and Dumont #2 forceps with RNaseZAP and MilliQ water, then autoclave in a small bag.
Reconstitute PHOX2B antibody by adding 500 µL of sterile, RNase free PBS to 100 µg of antibody (final concentration 0.2 mg/mL); aliquot into 50 µL and store at -20°C.
Prepare Lysis buffer and Staining buffer and place on ice.
Schedule FACS sort (MoFlo Astrios or equivalent, 70 micron nozzle, DAPI/Hoechst detection) and 10x Genomics Sequencing run.

steps.title: Tissue Processing and Cryosectioning
steps.instruction: Isolate the muscularis layer and prepare frozen sections.

substeps.instruction: Transfer tissue on ice from Pathology in sterile ice cold 1x PBS in a 50 mL conical container.
Don PPE (gloves, lab coat, face mask, face shield).
Pour cold 1x Dulbeccos PBS and tissue into a new sterile dish.
Trim surrounding fat using Dumont #2 forceps and fine scissors.
Carefully cut off submucosa and epithelium, leaving only the muscularis.
Cut muscularis into small pieces (~5 x 5 mm).
Label cryomolds as 'muscularis+plexus'.
Transfer tissue pieces into cryomolds half-filled with RNase Free Tissue-Plus O.C.T. Compound and cover with O.C.T.
Freeze the mold in 2-Methylbutane in the fume hood for 5 minutes, then store in a -80°C freezer in labeled boxes/bags.
Record human subject information linked to the specimen.

steps.title: Sectioning and RNA Quality Control
steps.instruction: Collect tissue sections and extract RNA for quality analysis.

substeps.instruction: RNaseZAP Dumont #2 Forceps and rinse with deionized MilliQ water.
Transfer 'Plexus' cryomold on dry ice to a Cryostat set to -20°C.
Freeze tissue onto a metal mounting device using minimal O.C.T. compound.
Chill Dumont #2 Forceps in the cryostat.
Pre-cool three DNA LoBind tubes ('Muscularis+Plexus', 'Muscularis+Plexus', and 'Muscularis+Plexus RNA') on dry ice or at -20°C for at least 3 minutes.
Make 100 micron sections.
Collect all sections in 'Muscularis+Plexus' tubes, except for 2-5 random sections which go into the 'Muscularis+Plexus RNA' tube.
Return tissue tubes to -80°C on dry ice.

steps.title: RNA Extraction and Analysis
steps.instruction: Extract RNA from the designated RNA samples using RNeasy MinElute columns.

substeps.instruction: Add 350 uL of buffer RLT plus to the RNA tubes.
Run through gDNA spin column; centrifuge for 30s at >=8,000xg (10,000g recommended).
Add one volume (~350 uL) of 70% ethanol to the flow-through, mix by pipetting 4 times, and proceed immediately without centrifuging.
Transfer sample and precipitate to an RNeasy MinElute spin column in a 2 mL collection tube; centrifuge for 15s at >8,000g and discard flow-through.
Add 700 uL of buffer RW1; centrifuge for 15s at 8,000g (10,000 RCF) and discard flow-through.
Add 500 uL Buffer RPE; centrifuge for 15s at >8,000g.
Add 500 uL of 80% ethanol; centrifuge for 2 minutes at 8,000g (10,000 RCF) and discard collection tube.
Place column in a new 2 mL collection tube and centrifuge at full speed for 5 minutes to dry the membrane.
Place column in a new 1.5 mL collection tube, add 14 uL of RNase free water to the center of the membrane, and centrifuge for 1 minute at full speed to elute RNA.
Analyze RNA using Agilent RNA 2100 Bioanalyzer with Agilent RNA 6000 Pico Kit.

steps.title: Nuclei Isolation and Homogenization
steps.instruction: Release nuclei from the frozen tissue sections.

substeps.instruction: Rinse large iridectomy scissors and Dumont #2 forceps with RNase Zap and MilliQ water; pre-cool on ice in a 50 mL conical.
Fill wells of a 6-well plate on ice with 6 mL of Lysis buffer.
Don PPE approximately 1 hour before FACS sort.
Transfer one Eppendorf tube of sectioned tissue into 6 mL of Lysis buffer in the 6-well plate.
Chop rapidly with large iridectomy scissors for 1 minute.
Transfer 2 mL of Lysis buffer and tissue/O.C.T. into a pre-cooled Dounce homogenizer.
Homogenize with 20 strokes of the loose pestle and 50 strokes of the tight pestle (use paper towel cover to avoid splashes from foam).
Pass the homogenate through a 30 micron MACS SmartStrainer into a 50 mL conical.
Chase with 2 mL of Lysis buffer; replace strainers if clogged, between samples, or after 3 uses.
Repeat for all tissue from the patient; combined nuclei from the same patient may be pooled in one 50 mL conical.
Centrifuge at 590 RCG for 8 minutes at 4°C.

steps.title: Nuclei Staining and Immunoselection
steps.instruction: Label nuclei with Hoechst and PHOX2B antibody for sorting.

substeps.instruction: Carefully remove supernatant using a Pipet-Aid and P1000, leaving a small amount of liquid to avoid disturbing the pellet.
Resuspend nuclei in 990 mL staining buffer by pipetting 5-10 times with a P1000.
Add 100 µL of Normal Donkey Serum for blocking.
Add 1 µL of 2.5 mg/mL Hoechst.
Divide nuclei into three labeled Eppendorf tubes: Isotype control, Phox2b #1, and Phox2b #2 (330 µL per tube).
Add 3.3 µL (3.3 µg) of goat IgG to the isotype control tube.
Add 16.5 µL of PHOX2B antibody (3.3 µg) to Phox2b tubes #1 and #2.
Rotate samples on a Glas-Col Rotator at speed 30 in the cold room for 45 minutes.
Add 1 mL of 1x PBS rinse buffer to each tube and centrifuge for 5 minutes at 400 RCF at 4°C.
Remove supernatant without disturbing the pellet.
Resuspend pellet in 400 µL of 1:400 Alexa Fluor 647 Donkey anti-goat secondary antibody in staining buffer; pipette 5-10 times to remove clumps.
Rotate samples at speed 30 in the cold room for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Final Cleanup and FACS Sorting
steps.instruction: Filter nuclei and sort for PHOX2B+ populations.

substeps.instruction: While rotating, prepare collection tubes (1.5 mL Eppendorf with 5 uL staining buffer) and Falcon round-bottom tubes for each patient; keep on ice.
Add 1 mL of 1x PBS rinse buffer to the nuclei; centrifuge for 5 minutes at 400 RCF at 4°C.
Resuspend in 1 mL of staining buffer, pipetting 5-10 times to disrupt clumps.
Strain the liquid through a FlowMi strainer into a spare Eppendorf tube using a P1000 tip.
Strain the liquid again through the lid of a Falcon round-bottom tube.
Transport samples and collection tubes to FACS on ice.
Run the isotype control first to determine gating.
Sort Hoechst+, PHOX2B+ nuclei (higher signal than isotype) into collection tubes using a 70 micron nozzle.
Save the FACS program for documentation.
Optional: Verify nuclei integrity and Hoechst staining by viewing 10 uL of a 1:19 dilution (0.5 uL sorted sample in 9.5 uL Staining Buffer) on a hemocytometer under an epifluorescent microscope.
